# Extract the row for "Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps"
outside_deaths = df[df['Description Losses'] == 'Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps']

# Get the year columns (excluding 'Description Losses' and 'Total')
year_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['Description Losses', 'Total']]

# Find the year with the maximum value in that row
max_year = outside_deaths[year_cols].idxmax(axis=1).iloc[0]

# Extract just the year part (e.g., "1943/44" -> "1943")
answer = max_year.split('/')[0]
answer
